t: 阿格里帕·波斯图穆斯(Agrippa Postumus)是后罗马皇帝奥古斯都的母孙,流亡期间被…
te: Agrippa Postumus, maternal grandson of the late Roman emperor Augustus, is executed by his guards while in exile.
dz: 阿格里帕·波斯图穆斯(Agrippa Postumus)是后罗马皇帝奥古斯都的母孙,流亡期间被他的守卫处死.
de: Agrippa Postumus, maternal grandson of the late Roman emperor Augustus, is executed by his guards while in exile.

t: 奥古斯都的葬礼举行. 他的尸体被火化并放入了自己的陵墓.
te: The funeral of Augustus takes place. His body is cremated and placed in his mausoleum.
dz: 奥古斯都的葬礼举行. 他的尸体被火化并放入了自己的陵墓.
de: The funeral of Augustus takes place. His body is cremated and placed in his mausoleum.

t: 罗马元老院决定废黜已故皇帝奥古斯都.
te: The Roman Senate decides to deify the late emperor Augustus.
dz: 罗马元老院决定废黜已故皇帝奥古斯都.
de: The Roman Senate decides to deify the late emperor Augustus.
